svg.title: Structured output: concepts, workflow and schema examples
svg.desc: Colour-coded panels and labelled icons distinguish schema definition, sending input, generation, validation, parsing and integration.
svg.text: An AI response that follows a predefined
structure or schema: instead of free-
form text, the model returns data
“Acme Corp is a company that was founded in
Common formats: JSON · XML · tables / CSV · custom objects (Pydantic, …)
Be explicit: clear field descriptions and rules
Keep schemas as simple as possible
Use examples in your prompt when helpful
Version your schema as it evolves
Typical use cases: information extraction, e-commerce, CRM,
